common.footerNote: You're receiving this email because of a recent order or account activity at {{storeName}}.

orderPlaced.subject: We've received your order {{orderNumber}}
orderPlaced.preheader: Thank you for your order {{orderNumber}}. Here's what you chose.
orderPlaced.heading: Your order is in
orderPlaced.intro: Thanks for your order. We'll email you again as soon as your payment clears.
orderPlaced.nextSteps: Nothing to do right now — we'll take it from here.

orderPaid.subject: Payment received for order {{orderNumber}}
orderPaid.preheader: Your payment for {{orderNumber}} is in and your order is being prepared.
orderPaid.heading: Payment confirmed
orderPaid.intro: We've received your payment and your order is being prepared.
orderPaid.nextSteps: We'll let you know the moment it ships.

orderCancelled.subject: Your order {{orderNumber}} has been cancelled
orderCancelled.heading: Your order has been cancelled
orderCancelled.intro: This order will not be fulfilled, and the items have gone back into stock.
orderCancelled.nextSteps: If you paid for this order, we will arrange your refund separately. Reply to this email if anything looks wrong.

orderReturned.subject: We've received your return for order {{orderNumber}}
orderReturned.preheader: Order {{orderNumber}} has come back to us.
orderReturned.heading: Your return has reached us
orderReturned.intro: This order has come back to us and is now closed.
orderReturned.nextSteps: If you paid for this order, we will arrange your refund separately. Reply to this email if anything looks wrong.

orderDelivered.subject: Your order {{orderNumber}} has arrived
orderDelivered.preheader: Order {{orderNumber}} has been delivered. We hope you love it.
orderDelivered.heading: Your parcel has arrived
orderDelivered.intro: Your order has been delivered. We hope you love it.
orderDelivered.nextSteps: If anything is not right, reply to this email and we will put it straight.

shipmentDispatched.subject: Your order {{orderNumber}} is on its way
shipmentDispatched.preheader: Order {{orderNumber}} has shipped. Here's how to follow it.
shipmentDispatched.heading: Your order has shipped
shipmentDispatched.intro: Your parcel is with the carrier.

passwordResetCode.subject: Your {{storeName}} password reset code
passwordResetCode.preheader: Use this code within {{minutes}} minutes to choose a new password.
passwordResetCode.heading: Reset your password
passwordResetCode.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your {{storeName}} account. Enter this code in the app to choose a new one.
passwordResetCode.expiry: This code expires in {{minutes}} minutes and can be used once.
passwordResetCode.ignore: Didn't ask for this? You can safely ignore this email — your password stays the same.
passwordResetCode.nextSteps: For your security, never share this code with anyone, including our team.

passwordChanged.subject: Your {{storeName}} password was changed
passwordChanged.preheader: The password for your {{storeName}} account was just changed.
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.intro: The password for your {{storeName}} account was just reset, and you have been signed out on every device.
passwordChanged.notYou: If you didn't make this change, contact us straight away at
passwordChanged.nextSteps: You can now sign in with your new password.
